para.text: No later than one year after [September 25, 2026], the Mayor, pursuant to [subchapter I of Chapter 5 of Title 2], shall issue rules to implement the provisions of this part; provided, that both a glazier representative and glazing contractor representative have been appointed to the Board as required by § 47-2853.06(d).

If a glazier representative and glazing contractor representative are not appointed within 180 days after [September 25, 2026], the Mayor shall begin the rulemaking process to implement the provisions of this part, to be complete within no later than one year after [September 25, 2026].
